2. On instructions, learned counsel for the petitioner fairly conceded that he is not pressing prayer (a) and is only vehemently pressing prayer (b), which is regarding the payment of compensation to the petitioner.
3. At this stage, learned counsel appearing on behalf of the respondents prays for some time to take instructions regarding payment of compensation to the petitioner as prayed in prayer (b).
4.
Let the instructions be filed in writing within four weeks.

5. List on 26th March, 2025.
CHANDRA DHARI SINGH, J.
